create_meeting.description: Create a video meeting room and get the link participants join with. The room opens straight away and stays available until an hour after its end time. Cloud recording, transcription and streaming need a paid Whereby Embedded plan.
create_meeting.name: create_meeting

parameters.description: When the meeting ends. Must be now or later.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Normal suits up to 4 participants; Group is for more.
parameters.name: room_mode

parameters.description: Starts the room name, e.g. 'support' gives /support-<random>. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 39.
parameters.name: room_name_prefix

parameters.description: How the random part of the room name looks.
parameters.name: room_name_pattern

parameters.description: Lock the room so only hosts can let people in. Guests knock and wait.
parameters.name: is_locked

parameters.description: Set the room up for broadcasting to viewers: locked, group mode, with host and viewer links returned.
parameters.name: viewer_mode

parameters.description: Extra links to include. The host link makes whoever opens it a host, so share it carefully.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: How the meeting can be recorded. Leave empty for the organisation's setting. Cloud needs a paid plan.
parameters.name: recording_type

parameters.description: When a cloud recording starts. Leave empty for the organisation's setting.
parameters.name: recording_start_trigger

options.label: Started by hand in the meeting
Prompt the first person who can start it
Start when the first participant joins
Start when the second participant joins

parameters.description: When live transcription starts. 'Started by hand' here means it is not available. Paid plans only.
parameters.name: live_transcription_start_trigger

options.label: Host starts and stops it by hand
Start when the first participant joins
Start when the second participant joins

parameters.description: The spoken language to transcribe. Leave empty for the organisation's setting.
parameters.name: live_transcription_language

parameters.description: Show live captions to every participant.
parameters.name: live_captions

parameters.description: Stream the meeting live to this RTMP address, e.g. rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2/<stream key>.
parameters.name: streaming_url

parameters.description: When the live stream starts.
parameters.name: streaming_start_trigger

options.label: Started by hand in the meeting
Start when the first participant joins

endDate.description: When the meeting ends, in UTC.

hostRoomUrl.description: A link that makes whoever opens it a host. Only returned when requested; share it carefully.

meetingId.description: The meeting's id, which Get and Delete meeting take.

roomName.description: The room's name with a leading slash, e.g. /example-prefix-793e9ec1-c686-423d-9043-9b7a10c553fd. The room branding and Insights actions take it.

roomUrl.description: The link participants open to join the meeting.

startDate.description: When the meeting started, in UTC.

viewerRoomUrl.description: A link that joins as a viewer without camera or microphone. Only returned when requested.

create_transcription.description: Start transcribing a recording. It runs in the background: check Get Whereby transcription until its state is ready. Paid plans only.
create_transcription.name: create_transcription

parameters.description: The recording's id, from List recordings.
parameters.name: recording_id

delete_meeting.description: Delete a meeting. Everyone in the room is removed and the link stops working. Deleting one that is already gone succeeds.
delete_meeting.name: delete_meeting

parameters.description: The meeting. Pick one from the list, or pass the meetingId from a Create or List meetings step.
parameters.name: meeting_id

alreadyDeleted.description: True if the meeting was already gone (Whereby answered HTTP 404) rather than deleted by this call.

delete_recording.description: Permanently delete a recording. If it is already gone, Whereby answers HTTP 404 for the lookup and this still reports success, with alreadyDeleted set to true.
delete_recording.name: delete_recording

parameters.description: The recording's id, from List recordings.
parameters.name: recording_id

alreadyDeleted.description: True if the recording was already gone (Whereby answered HTTP 404) rather than deleted by this call.

delete_transcription.description: Permanently delete a transcription. If it is already gone, Whereby answers HTTP 404 for the lookup and this still reports success, with alreadyDeleted set to true.
delete_transcription.name: delete_transcription

parameters.description: The transcription's id, from List or Create transcription.
parameters.name: transcription_id

alreadyDeleted.description: True if the transcription was already gone (Whereby answered HTTP 404) rather than deleted by this call.

get_room_insights.description: Usage totals per room: sessions, participant minutes, unique participants and ratings. Data can lag 10 to 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Filter by room name. Leave empty for every room.

parameters.description: A field and direction, e.g. totalSessions:desc. Whereby does not list the sortable fields; the numeric fields in the results are the ones to try.

parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Default 10.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The cursor from the previous page, to get the next one.
parameters.name: cursor

count.description: Number of results on this page.
